name: Runemaster Elemental Assassin converts Agility into spell power, spell critical and hit ratings (#991)
contract: Tooltip 705541: spell damage +$s2% of Agility, spell critical strike +$s1% of Agility, hit rating +$s3%.
Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT (220): MiscValue 1024 = 1 << CR_CRIT_SPELL, MiscValueB 1, 10.
Effect 2 is aura 220 for MiscValue 224 = CR_HIT_MELEE | CR_HIT_RANGED | CR_HIT_SPELL, MiscValueB 1, 5.
Both aura types are native: Unit::SpellBaseDamageBonusDone and Player::UpdateRating read them.
The audit's premise (spell ID absent from source) does not apply to native aura types.
A +100 Agility buff therefore adds 20 spell power, 10 spell critical rating and 5 of each hit rating.
Without the passive the same buff adds none. Regression evidence for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let the character settle
Frost spell power without the passive
Spell critical rating without the passive
Spell hit rating without the passive
Fixture: +100 Agility
Control: Agility alone adds no spell power
Control: Agility alone adds no spell critical rating
Control: Agility alone adds no spell hit rating
Elemental Assassin passive is active
Agility-to-spell-critical amount is 10
Agility-to-spell-power amount is 20
Agility-to-hit amount is 5
Spell power with the passive on base Agility
Spell critical rating with the passive
Melee hit rating with the passive
Ranged hit rating with the passive
Spell hit rating with the passive
Reapply +100 Agility
+100 Agility adds 20% of itself as spell power
+100 Agility adds 10% of itself as spell critical rating
+100 Agility adds 5% of itself as melee hit rating
+100 Agility adds 5% of itself as ranged hit rating
+100 Agility adds 5% of itself as spell hit rating
Removing the Agility buff returns spell power to the passive baseline
